attention4.ptxt: If excessive negative pressure is applied, the MAP sensor may be damaged.
Do not exceed negative pressure of –70 kPa (–0.7 kgf/cm2, –10.2 psi, –0.7 bar).

s1.ptxt: Check MAP sensor output voltage as follows.
If faulty condition is found, replace MAP sensor.

s2.ptxt: Arrange 3 new 1.5 V batteries (1) in series, and check that total voltage is 4.5 to 5.0 V.
Connect voltmeter (2), special tool and batteries to MAP sensor (3) as shown in figure and set the tool in “VACUUM” mode.

attention3.ptxt: Before using special tool (vacuum pump gauge), read its Operator’s Manual to know how to use it.

s2.ptxt: Check that voltage varies gradually when negative pressure is gradually applied with special tool.

attention3.ptxt: Environmental condition affects output voltage largely.
The sensor voltage below is reference value when measuring under the following conditions.

item.ptxt: Atmospheric pressure: 101.3 kPa (1.0 kgf/ cm2, 14.7 psi, 1.01 bar)
